courtyard.why: The gate is kept and manned. Nobody bars a warden with a petition.

blackwood.why: The low road, and the patrol that walks it.

cathedral.why: The cathedral is whole, and its doors are the Crown's.

crypt.why: The crypt is not yet flooded, and not yet open.

roost.why: A far light on the mountain.

citadel.why: The winter king still keeps his gates.

deep.why: Nobody alive knows there is anything under the throne.

throne.why: A warden may petition the throne.

deep.why: The door the Witness remembers. It opens from the other side of the throne.

0.label: The Low Road
0.hint: The patrol knows a warden's colours. It has orders all the same.

6.label: The Hollow Throne
6.hint: He comes down the steps himself.

0.label: The Breach
0.hint: New plate, new recruits. The Crown replaces what it loses.

2.label: The Barbican
2.hint: The banner is down. The one who stood under it was not replaced.

4.label: The Gate Passage
4.hint: Something larger has been posted where the Breaker stood.

6.label: The Inner Ward
6.hint: A guardian stands in the Sentinel's post. You know the way it stands.

6.label: The Inner Ward
6.hint: The post is empty. Two sets of footprints, and one blade's mark in the stone.

0.label: The Lantern Road
0.hint: The lanterns are out. Something moves between them anyway.

1.label: The Road
1.hint: Bootprints, old ones, going one way.

1.label: The Deer Trail
1.hint: White antlers, greyer now, between the trunks.

2.label: The Briar Gate
2.hint: The briars were cut through years ago, and never grew back.

4.label: The Woodpile
4.hint: The stacks have rotted where they stood.

6.label: The Clearing
6.hint: The stumps have been torn out of the ground.

0.label: The Pilgrim Stair
0.hint: The robes are new. The hymn is not.

1.label: The Porch
1.hint: The great censer lies where it fell.

2.label: The Cathedral Steps
2.hint: Nobody is waiting on the steps.

4.label: The Choir Loft
4.hint: The choir is silent. The bell is not.

6.label: The Lower Door
6.hint: Under the crossing, where the bronze lay, a door stands open.

0.label: The Drowned Stair
0.hint: The water is lower. What it covered is not gone.

4.label: The Gallery of Kings
4.hint: Something crawls where the wardens walked.

6.label: The Way Down
6.hint: Behind the first tomb, a stair. Something at the foot of it says a name.

6.label: The Way Down
6.hint: The stair goes down to an emptied place.

0.label: The Glass Road
0.hint: The scale is new. The oath is the old one.

2.label: The Boneyard
2.hint: The keeper of the clutch has come down to the bones.

6.label: The Summit
6.hint: A shadow crosses the sun, and comes back.

6.label: The Summit
6.hint: The old one has come down from the hall to the empty nest.

0.label: The Frozen Rank
0.hint: The ranks have thawed. One of them kept his post.

1.label: The Wall Walk
1.hint: The duellist's footprints are worn into the ice. He is not in them.

4.label: The Great Stair
4.hint: It has made its den on the landing.

6.label: The Winter Throne
6.hint: The king is gone. What he kept chained has climbed to his seat.

6.label: The Winter Throne
6.hint: The pit is empty. Her brood has taken the hall.

0.label: The King's Door
0.hint: The King's Shadow stands where the Gatekeeper stood.

1.label: The Antechamber
1.hint: The king's own blade does not bow to you. He is not here.

2.label: The Steps
2.hint: A crown lies on the steps. Nobody is turning it.

4.label: The Last Post
4.hint: A herald, with nothing left to announce.

5.label: The Roof of the Hall
5.hint: Something vast is still folded among the rafters.

6.label: The Hollow Throne
6.hint: The floor of the hall stands open.

0.label: The Long Stair
0.hint: The ones along the wall have turned round.

1.label: The Gallery of Names
1.hint: No more names have gone from the wall.

2.label: The Grain
2.hint: It wears a name it took.

4.label: The Oath Hall
4.hint: It was put in the ground and did not stay.

6.label: The Bottom
6.hint: It says a name. It might be yours.

6.label: The Eternal Crown
6.hint: The lowest room. The machine is here, and it is waiting to be told.

ashen_sentinel.why: His post was given to another.

hollow_executioner.why: The clearing was empty for twenty-four years.

crimson_widow.why: She is not waiting on the steps.

cathedral_beast.why: Its fall uncovered the lower door.

gravewarden.why: Behind the first tomb there was always a way down.

frostbound_king.why: He gave up his crown. What he kept chained did not.

pale_huntsman.why: If he fell, the trail is empty.

cinder_wyrm.why: The old one comes down to the empty nest.

rimewyrm.why: What she left in the pit grew.

devourer.why: The bottom is an emptied place.

kingsblade.why: The king's own blade was not replaced.

crownless.why: Only the crown is left on the steps.

records.name: The First Oath
records.text: What the first of the house sent out through the sword.

records.name: The Measure of Him
records.text: How he fights, set down by one who crossed blades with him and was winning.

records.name: The Broken Crown
records.text: The count behind the seal, carried out whole.

records.name: The Crown Can Bleed
records.text: He was beaten once, in a fair fight, and the machines stood him up again.

records.name: The Surviving Version
records.text: Thirty records of what the Crown rewrote.

records.name: The Siege That Outlived Its War
records.text: What was kept under the Roost, faced.

records.name: The Partition Key
records.text: What the Devourer was made of, and how it was unmade.

records.name: One Who Was Kept
records.text: A stored mind that was asked, and chose.

1.note: The story takes the fight on a cut the player lands, not on a health bar. Nothing here is won or lost.

2.note: At the threshold the seal burns: press the attack, or save the records. A player who wins is recorded as having won.

echo.name: The Crownless Champion
echo.title: The Kept
echo.intro: It is wearing what you wore. It stands the way you stood.
